title: platform checklist: the automation recipe stores qa_no_start_node through the metadata door to reach the trigger 422 row, which PR #32273 makes unreachable
body:
domain:server#7 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYm8sWjp2Pk76warN7w

Filing gate: ① a defect with a named site in test tooling, found by the #32142 card thread (os-dev report 6772313568, out-of-scope finding) and confirmed by the contract review of PR #32273 (record 6772843445, ③). ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: the next run of the automation checklist area fails or reports a false gap on the "never-dispatched" rows, because the probe flow it seeds can no longer be armed.
Reader: triage first touch; the recipe lives in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json` (the checklist owner's surface).

## Where

The recipe stores the probe flow `qa_no_start_node` through `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/qa_no_start_node` so that the trigger door answers the `#9378` table's `422 FLOW_NO_START_NODE` row. After PR #32273 the engine refuses that flow at registration: the read says `registration: refused`, and the trigger answers `404`. The recipe's own text predicted this ("a publish-time check landing makes that step 4xx"). re-check: `git grep -n "qa_no_start_node" origin/main -- docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json` (control: `qa_always_fails` in the same file).

## Expected

The item asserts what a start-less flow meets now (the save refusal on the automation door, `registration: refused` on the metadata read, `404` at the trigger), or the row moves to whatever the #32142 follow-ups rule for `FLOW_NO_START_NODE`.

Dedupe (open and closed), run 2026-11-10 16:27 UTC: `qa_no_start_node checklist` (3 hits: #32142 the parent; #24779 and #28942 are QA run records).
